authorization: 2026-10-25 owner explicitly requests Luna retry and Terra experiment to seek lower cost after passing Sol baseline.
scope: Same saved sources, final committed brief/input/output contract, model-only candidate comparison. No provider/FX calls or runtime changes.
success_criteria: One natural connected answer with individually useful explanations of meaningful Ranking-informed highlights; no repeated self-contained mini-answers.
Exact journey references embedded where useful, with model-controlled order/count and no cabin/style quota.
Relevant alternatives and available cash baseline integrated into the choice argument; cash remains outside award recommendations.
Limitations consolidated in a readable passage identifying affected options; material booking, traveler, cabin, price and freshness uncertainty preserved.
Independent review identifies no unresolved material source-factual or composition defect; mechanical checks alone do not pass this criterion.
Incomplete case truthfully has no complete recommendations and discusses only source-supported leads without inventing usable connections.
All eligible journeys independently survive in the explorer, regardless of authored selection or failure.
New artifacts replay exactly; original diagnostic bytes stay unchanged and intentional original V6 preparation mismatch is recorded.
iteration_policy: Admitted sentinel first. Independent source and composition review must pass before conditional/incomplete. Max one cohort/6generation+6counts per model, <=2 attempts per run. No automatic retry. Preserve rejected candidates and report measured cost.
claim_limits: Development/source-backed AI review, not owner acceptance, frontend quality, M3 qualification, independent holdout or traveler task benefit.
